newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was quiet late Tuesday. There were not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for a market test. Inquiry and demand were moderate.
Cattle priced at $71.00-72.00, bids $68.00-69.00, last established price $69.00 on Thursday, Feb. 27. Week to date 8,800 head confirmed, mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle.
